notes.title: More Quality of Life Improvements - 1.4.19
notes.content:
Hi folks, 

Here are some of the enhancements we've been working on: 

Character Upgrade Additions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/73fe1f7cfb123fef8726a0afbb0525e399414920.png

 Reforging: A new upgrade that enhances how you use upgrade forges scattered throughout the worlds.
 Reduced resonant crystal cost of starter rune-related upgrades (if you've purchased them, some crystals will be refunded).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/e0ea9d530529ac9b658fabc9ccdd41732a6687c5.gifTip: Resonant crystals can be earned by unlocking items or world shortcuts. You can toggle upgrades on/off anytime in exchange for run XP.

Dynamic control scheme detection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32575180/3501cfb09a6b2d08b4fb0fef92c625b31b315d5e.png
The game now automatically detects if you're using gamepad/mouse control schemes. Swapping every time a button is clicked (instead of prompting you). You can toggle this on/off in the controls menu.

Localization Improvements
We've continued to improve localization across menus and gameplay elements.

Other quality of life changes

 New startup loading screen.
 User interface improvements. E.g., World and level number shown in the HUD instead of level/maxLevel. Visual fixes to unlock-related menus.
 Weapons/Gadgets/Spells can only be reforged 3 times by default (though you can upgrade this limit), to encourage swapping between different equipment.


As always, your feedback is most welcome!

Have fun!

notes.title: Quality of life enhancements
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers!

Here's more of we've been working on since launch:


 Reworked Tutorial: We've reworked it to be more intuitive and forgiving, based on player feedback.
 Localization improvements to all languages.
 Tackling: Increased damage and stun aspect of grabbing and throwing opponents at each other. We also made the UI prompt for it clearer.
Tip: you can grab and throw most opponents while they're stunned or unaware of you.
 Hard Mode Rework: 

 Added a new achievement for completing a world on hard mode.
 All bosses have faster attack patterns.
Note: For one boss, you may need to have completed the first area before the new updated patterns appear.
 All bosses have increased hp.

 Reworked the Blood Thirsty character background perk, toning down the HP regained from bosses and limiting the number of orbs drawn at a time.
Tip: You can unlock character background perks by rescuing someone in the Catacombs..
 Multiple UI enhancements, especially related to prompts.
 Considerable optimization work to allow the game to run faster on older devices.


Thank you to everyone for the interest and time playing our game 💖. Special thanks to those of you who took a moment to leave a review - even a single word helps a lot with visibility on Steam.

notes.title: Game Launched!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RkVpiC0YxY4;full][/previewyoutube]
Greetings adventurers!

After several years of development the free edition of our chaotic tactical rogue-like platformer is finally Released!

For those who played the recent pre-release build, some of the updates since include:

 The game is now Steam Deck Verified.
 Added multiple new items including a spinning steel hatchet, flying lantern pet, and whips.
 Added challenge arenas to the Gnarled Gardens and the Celestial Catacombs.
 Several additional enemy types.
 Added a new boss - the Colossal Worm.
 2 additional music tracks.
 6 new runes that synergize with each other in different ways.
 1 new spell modifier.
 Additional dialog and animated portraits.
 Added speedrun timer.
 You can grab and throw most opponents that haven't detected you yet (in addition to when they're stunned).
 Significant UI polish
 Substantial localization work.
 Steam Achievements
 Steam Cloud and Stats.
 And much more..!



Thank you to everyone for the interest and time playing our game 💖. Special thanks to those of you who took a moment to leave a review - even a single word helps a lot with visibility on Steam.
